description: This file initializes and manages an Electron application window, setting dimensions and preventing the default behavior when all windows are closed.

methods.name: app.whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when Electron has finished initialization.

methods.name: new BrowserWindow
methods.description: Creates a new browser window with specified dimensions.

methods.name: win.loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL into the Electron BrowserWindow.

methods.name: app.on
methods.description: Adds an event listener for Electron app events, here used for 'window-all-closed'.
